situations.title: ARDS 산소화 지표 이해
situations.tagline: The doctor keeps mentioning his P to F ratio — what does that number mean for him?
situations.brief: P/F ratio와 중증도의 관계를 이해하고 가족에게 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: That ratio tells us how well his lungs are moving oxygen into his blood.
A lower number means his lung injury is more severe right now.
We track it to see whether his lungs are improving.
goals: P/F ratio가 산소화 중증도를 나타냄을 이해한다

situations.title: 저 TV 폐보호 환기 유지
situations.tagline: Can you double-check his tidal volume — I want to keep his driving pressure low.
situations.brief: driving pressure 개념을 이해하며 저 TV 폐보호 환기를 유지하세요.
keyPhrases: His tidal volume is set to 6 milliliters per kilo of ideal body weight.
Keeping the driving pressure low protects his injured lungs.
Let's confirm the plateau pressure stays under 30.
goals: 저 TV 폐보호 환기 설정을 확인한다

situations.title: 복와위 적응증·금기 확인
situations.tagline: Before we prone him, can we confirm he's actually a good candidate?
situations.brief: proning 대상 여부를 판단하기 위해 적응증과 금기를 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: His severe hypoxemia makes him a candidate for proning.
Let's rule out contraindications like an unstable spine or open abdomen.
I'll confirm there's no reason we shouldn't turn him.

situations.title: 복와위 체위 준비·물품
situations.tagline: Let's get the team and the padding ready before we flip him — what do you need?
situations.brief: 팀과 패딩을 준비해 복와위 체위 전환을 안전하게 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: We'll need at least five people to turn him safely.
Place padding for his chest, pelvis, and face before we roll.
Let's secure all his lines and the tube before we start.
goals: 복와위 전환에 필요한 인력과 물품을 준비한다

situations.title: 복와위 중 압박점 관찰
situations.tagline: He's been face-down for a while — should I be checking his face and chest for pressure marks?
situations.brief: 복와위 중 안면과 흉부의 압박점을 관찰해 욕창을 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's check his forehead, cheeks, and chest for pressure areas.
We reposition his head every couple of hours to relieve pressure.
Any redness on the face needs padding adjusted right away.
goals: 욕창 예방을 위한 체위 조정을 시행한다

situations.title: 산소화 반응 모니터
situations.tagline: His oxygen numbers before and after we turned him — are they actually better now?
situations.brief: proning 전후 SpO2를 비교해 산소화 반응을 모니터하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's compare his oxygen from before proning to now.
His saturation improved from 88 to 95 after the turn.
I'll document the response so the team can see the trend.

situations.title: 복와위 안전 전환 팀 협조
situations.tagline: Everyone ready? On my count, we roll him toward me — protect those lines.
situations.brief: 롤 술기와 라인 보호를 통해 복와위 안전 전환에 팀으로 협조하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll hold the airway and call the count for the roll.
Each person guards their lines as we turn him together.
On three, we roll him smoothly onto his stomach.
goals: 복와위 롤 술기를 팀과 조율해 수행한다

situations.title: 복와위 중 튜브·라인 관리
situations.tagline: With him face-down, I'm worried a line or the tube could get pulled — how do we keep them safe?
situations.brief: 복와위 중 우발적 제거를 예방하며 튜브와 라인을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's route the lines up over his shoulders to avoid tension.
I'll check the tube depth and securement every hour.
Keep the drainage lines free so nothing gets pinched underneath him.
goals: 복와위 중 라인 배치로 우발적 제거를 예방한다

situations.title: 복와위 중 장관영양 관리
situations.tagline: Can he still get his tube feeds while he's proned, or is that too risky?
situations.brief: 흡인 위험과 주입 속도를 고려해 복와위 중 장관영양을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: We can continue feeds, but let's keep the rate conservative.
Reverse Trendelenburg helps reduce his aspiration risk while proned.
I'll monitor his gastric residuals more closely in this position.
goals: 복와위 중 장관영양의 흡인 위험을 관리한다

situations.title: 신경근차단제 병용 감시
situations.tagline: He's paralyzed and proned now — how do we make sure he's deeply sedated enough?
situations.brief: 심부진정과 TOF를 감시하며 신경근차단제 병용을 안전하게 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Because he's paralyzed, he must be deeply sedated at all times.
I'll check the train-of-four to confirm the paralytic level.
We never let a paralyzed patient be under-sedated or aware.

situations.title: PEEP·recruitment 반응 평가
situations.tagline: After that recruitment maneuver, do you think his lungs actually opened up?
situations.brief: PEEP와 recruitment 반응을 평가해 폐 개방성을 판단하세요.
keyPhrases: His compliance improved after the recruitment maneuver.
Better oxygenation at the same PEEP suggests the lung opened up.
I'll watch for overdistension so we don't harm the good lung.
goals: recruitment 후 폐 개방성 반응을 평가한다

situations.title: 복와위 응답자 여부 판단
situations.tagline: His oxygen went up nicely — does that mean proning is working and we keep going?
situations.brief: 산소화 반응으로 복와위 응답자 여부를 판단하고 지속을 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: His oxygenation improved substantially, so he's a proning responder.
That supports continuing the prone sessions as planned.
I'll report the response so the team can set the schedule.

situations.title: 복와위 중 혈역학 변화 관리
situations.tagline: His blood pressure dropped after we turned him — is the proning causing this?
situations.brief: 복와위 중 저혈압에 대응해 혈역학 변화를 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: The position change can drop his blood pressure temporarily.
Let's check for line kinking and reduced venous return first.
I'll titrate fluids or pressors per protocol while we watch him.

situations.title: 안면 부종·안압 관리
situations.tagline: His face and eyes look so swollen from lying face-down — is that hurting his eyes?
situations.brief: 눈 보호와 부종 관리를 통해 안면 부종과 안압을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Facial swelling is common when he's face-down, and it eases when we turn him back.
We keep his eyes lubricated and protected to prevent injury.
We also position his head to avoid pressure on his eyes.
goals: 복와위 중 안면 부종과 안압을 관리한다
눈 보호 조치를 시행하고 가족에게 설명한다

situations.title: 앙와위 복귀 시점 판단
situations.tagline: He's done well — is it time to turn him back onto his back yet?
situations.brief: 산소화 유지를 확인하며 앙와위 복귀 시점을 판단하세요.
keyPhrases: He's maintained good oxygenation through the prone session.
If his oxygen holds after supination, we can keep him on his back.
Let's plan the turn as a team and watch his sats closely afterward.

situations.title: 복와위 중 급성 desaturation
situations.tagline: His sats are dropping fast while he's proned — what's happening, what do we check first?
situations.brief: 복와위 중 급성 desaturation의 원인을 감별하고 긴급 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Check the tube first for displacement or obstruction while he's prone.
I'll increase his FiO2 to 100 percent and call for help.
If we can't fix it, we prepare to turn him supine emergently.
goals: 복와위 중 급성 desaturation 원인을 감별한다

situations.title: 복와위 중 심정지 긴급 앙와위 전환
situations.tagline: He's coding face-down — we have to flip him to his back to start CPR, now!
situations.brief: 소생을 위해 복와위 심정지 환자를 긴급 앙와위로 전환하세요.
keyPhrases: Call the code and flip him supine so we can start compressions.
Protect the airway and lines as we turn him fast.
Start CPR the instant he's on his back.
goals: 복와위 심정지 시 긴급 앙와위 전환을 수행한다

situations.title: 복와위 중 우발적 발관
situations.tagline: The tube came out while he's face-down — his oxygen's crashing, help me!
situations.brief: 복와위 중 우발적 발관 위기에서 기도를 재확보하세요.
keyPhrases: The tube is out — turn him supine immediately to manage the airway.
Start bag-mask ventilation with 100 percent oxygen.
Call the airway team and get the reintubation cart now.
goals: 복와위 중 우발적 발관에 긴급 대응한다

situations.title: 난치성 저산소증 ECMO 의뢰
situations.tagline: Even proned and maxed out, his oxygen won't come up — should we be calling ECMO?
situations.brief: 난치성 저산소증에서 구조요법으로 ECMO 의뢰를 판단하고 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: He remains hypoxic despite proning and maximal ventilation.
This meets criteria to consult the ECMO team now.
I'll gather his gases, P/F ratio, and vent settings for the referral.
goals: 난치성 저산소증에서 ECMO 의뢰 기준을 판단한다

situations.title: 기흉·기압손상 동반 위기
situations.tagline: His pressures spiked and one side isn't moving — I think he blew a pneumothorax while proned.
situations.brief: 기흉과 기압손상 동반 위기에서 흉관과 환기 조정을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: High pressures with unequal breath sounds suggest a pneumothorax.
Lower the tidal volume and prepare for a chest tube.
I'll call the physician and set up for decompression.

situations.title: 복와위 중 안면 압박괴사 위기
situations.tagline: There's a deep dark sore forming on his cheek — the pressure is damaging his skin badly.
situations.brief: 조직손상을 인지하고 체위 조정으로 안면 압박괴사 위기를 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: This deep pressure injury needs the head repositioned right away.
Let's add padding and offload that area immediately.
I'll consult wound care and document the stage of injury.
goals: 복와위 중 안면 압박괴사를 조기에 인지한다
